title: Explicit Criteria for Finite-Time Identification in Sparse Primal--Dual Dynamics
summary: We study when selected coordinates become and remain zero in a finite-dimensional sparse-regression primal--dual flow and its exact full resolvent iteration. Invariant balls centered at \((0,z)\), with \(z\) strictly dual feasible, give computable deadlines without rank assumptions or optimizer knowledge. The certificates may be available at initialization. We determine the smallest invariant radius for the continuous flow within this family.
